item.tib: rgyas pa kun snang khyab pa rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor
item.coloph: khyung rdzong brag nas bla ma gyer gyis rnyed/ las skal yod dam rma sgom bdag la gnang / gter bdag gnyen nam cho 'phrul shin tu che ba/ byin rlabs che'am bkra shis mchog tu 'phel/ bla ma gyer gyi bka' gter 'di/ slob dpon rma ston srid 'dzin la dngos grub bab pa 'di/ las 'phro yod pa'i rma ston stag la bdag gis dka' blas nas zhus pa lags so//
